newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish shares end down, off lows, Merita bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: Finnish shares end down, off lows, Merita bucks trend.

text.p: Finnish shares closed broadly lower on Wednesday, but the market recovered some losses as U.S. economic data released late in the session were received well and U.S. bonds and stocks started higher on Wall Street.
The FOX derivatives and portfolio benchmark closed 0.85 percent down at 1,240 and the HEX general index shed 0.79 percent to 3,601.
Decliners led advancers by eight to two and volume was lively at 875 million markka, almost one-third in telecoms group Nokia, and with active trade also in bank Merita.
Merita bucked the negative trend, rising 0.20 markka to 22.90 after its first-half report came in at the top end of expectations, brokers said.
Forest industry group Enso fell 1.10 markka to 51.20 after it reported first half earnings in line with forecasts.
UPM-Kymmene, Europe's largest forestry group, fell 2.90 markka to 140.50 ahead of its January-June earnings report due for release on Thursday morning.
Nokia ended 3.50 markka lower at 465.50 markka.
